reader.notes: SumScaled adds scale-aligned Int128 values checked (size-escaped, never wrapped); IntrinsicResultType.Resolve selects Integer only when every argument is provably integer (IsIntegerOperand reads the literal FORM, the item's integer description, a nested call's resolved type), else Numeric, and the CHAR screen honours it. No edition switch on the value or type path. Witnesses g85_bf40_08 and 1989-RV-A_2_42_4-3 MATCH at 85.

All admitted as integer operands and values exact. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.42.4 RV2 'If the argument-1 series are all integers, the value returned is an integer'.
